name: 62232 · Caseyville, IL
findings: ZIP 62232 (Caseyville) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62232 (Caseyville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62232 (Caseyville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
